find-animal.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find a(n) animal. First, focus on the thing. Then, move it to the orange box in the workshop.
rules: Open closed doors before attempting to move through them.
Focus on a target animal before picking it up or moving it.
Pick up the animal to place it in inventory, then move it from inventory to the destination container.
Navigate through intermediate rooms and open any closed doors along the path to the destination.
Verify placement by looking in the destination container after moving the animal.

find-animal.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find a(n) animal. First, focus on the thing. Then, move it to the orange box in the workshop.
rules: Open closed containers and doors before attempting to look inside or move through them.
Search candidate rooms by opening doors, entering, and looking in containers until the target object is found.
Focus on the target object before picking it up.
Carry the picked-up object through connecting rooms to the destination container.
Move the carried object into the specified destination container to complete the task.

find-animal.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find a(n) animal. First, focus on the thing. Then, move it to the green box in the living room.
rules: Open the door to a room before moving into it, and open any closed container before attempting to pick up an animal from it.
Pick up the target animal from its source container, then navigate back through the connected rooms to the destination room.
Move the carried animal into the specified green box, then focus on the animal in the box to complete the task.
Use look/inventory observations to confirm the animal is in the box before focusing on it.

find-living-thing.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find a(n) living thing. First, focus on the thing. Then, move it to the green box in the bedroom.
rules: Focus on the target living thing before attempting to pick it up.
Pick up the focused living thing so it enters inventory, then open the door leading out of the current room.
Traverse rooms by going through opened doors in sequence toward the destination room.
Open the destination room's door before entering it.
Move the carried living thing from inventory into the specified green box in the destination room.

find-non-living-thing.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find a(n) non-living thing. First, focus on the thing. Then, move it to the red box in the bedroom.
rules: Focus on the target object before picking it up.
Pick up the target object to place it in inventory.
Open the door to the destination room before moving there.
Move to the destination room, then move the carried object into the specified container.
Choose a non-living portable object visible in the current room as the target.

find-non-living-thing.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find a(n) non-living thing. First, focus on the thing. Then, move it to the yellow box in the bedroom.
rules: Focus on the target object before picking it up.
Pick up the focused object to place it in inventory.
Open the door to the destination room before moving there.
Move to the destination room containing the target container.
Move the carried object from inventory into the target container.

find-plant.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find a(n) plant. First, focus on the thing. Then, move it to the purple box in the workshop.
rules: Open the door to the target room before attempting to travel there.
Travel to the room containing the plant, then pick up the living thing from its flower pot.
Return to the room containing the destination container and move the living thing into it.
After placing the plant, focus on the living thing to satisfy the focus requirement.
Use look/inventory observations to confirm the plant is in the container before focusing.

inclined-plane-friction-named-surfaces.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to determine which of the two inclined planes (steel, rubber) has the least friction. After completing your experiment, focus on the inclined plane with the least friction.
rules: Open the door to the target room before moving into it.
Move to the room containing the inclined planes and the object to be tested.
Inspect the inclined plane to confirm its surface before connecting the object.
Connect the object to the inclined plane, then focus on that plane to complete the friction comparison for that surface.
Repeat the connect-and-focus procedure for each candidate inclined plane, then focus on the plane with the least friction.

inclined-plane-friction-named-surfaces.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to determine which of the two inclined planes (plastic, platinum) has the least friction. After completing your experiment, focus on the inclined plane with the least friction.
rules: Open the door leading to the room containing the inclined planes before attempting to enter.
Inspect the target room and each candidate inclined plane before running the friction experiment.
Connect the test object to one inclined plane, then focus on that plane to observe the friction result.
Repeat the connect-and-focus procedure for each candidate plane to compare friction.
After comparing, focus on the inclined plane that exhibited the least friction.

inclined-plane-friction-named-surfaces.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to determine which of the two inclined planes (glass, caesium) has the most friction. After completing your experiment, focus on the inclined plane with the most friction.
rules: Open the door to a room before attempting to go to that room.
Navigate through connected rooms by opening doors and moving to the target room.
Use look around to survey the current room and identify objects such as inclined planes and blocks.
Connect the block to the inclined plane to set up the friction experiment.
Focus on the inclined plane to complete the observation of the friction experiment.

inclined-plane-friction-unnamed-surfaces.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to determine which of the two inclined planes (unknown material E, unknown material C) has the most friction. After completing your experiment, focus on the inclined plane with the most friction.
rules: Open the door to the target room before attempting to move into it.
Move through the hallway to reach the room containing the inclined planes.
Survey the room with look around to identify the inclined planes and other objects.
Examine each inclined plane with look at and focus on to compare their surfaces.
Focus on the inclined plane determined to have the most friction.

lifespan-longest-lived.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find the animal with the longest life span.  The animals are in the 'outside' location.  Focus on the animal with the longest life span.
rules: Open each closed door encountered along the path before moving through it.
Navigate room by room toward the target location where the animals are found.
Inspect candidate animals with look at to identify them before focusing.
Focus on the animal judged to have the longest life span to complete the task.
Keep the sequence of door-opening and room traversal steps in order; do not skip intermediate rooms.

lifespan-longest-lived-then-shortest-liv.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find the animal with the longest life span, then the shortest life span. First, focus on the animal with the longest life span.  Then, focus on the animal with the shortest life span. The animals are in the 'outside' location.
rules: Open the door to the target location before attempting to move there.
Move to the location where the animals are found.
Inspect each candidate animal with look at to identify it.
Focus on the animal with the longest life span first, then focus on the animal with the shortest life span.

lifespan-longest-lived-then-shortest-liv.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find the animal with the longest life span, then the shortest life span. First, focus on the animal with the longest life span.  Then, focus on the animal with the shortest life span. The animals are in the 'outside' location.
rules: Open the door to the target location before attempting to move there.
Move to the location containing the animals to be compared.
Inspect each candidate animal with a look action to identify it.
Focus on the animal selected as the current target to satisfy the focus requirement.
Repeat inspection and focus for each animal in the required order (longest lifespan first, then shortest).

lifespan-shortest-lived.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find the animal with the shortest life span.  The animals are in the 'outside' location.  Focus on the animal with the shortest life span.
rules: Open the connecting door before moving to a new room.
Move through the opened door to reach the location containing the candidate animals.
Inspect each candidate animal with look at to identify it.
Select the animal with the shortest life span and apply focus on to it.

lifespan-shortest-lived.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to find the animal with the shortest life span.  The animals are in the 'outside' location.  Focus on the animal with the shortest life span.
rules: Inspect each candidate animal in the location with 'look at' to identify it before choosing.
Compare the inspected animals' life spans and select the one with the shortest life span.
After identifying the target, apply 'focus on' to that animal to complete the task.
Keep the inspection and focus actions in the same location where the animals are present.

measure-melting-point-unknown-substance.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to measure the melting point of solid unknown substance C, which is located around the kitchen. First, focus on the thermometer. Next, focus on the solid unknown substance C. If the melting point of solid unknown substance C is above 10.0 degrees celsius, focus on the orange box. If the melting point of solid unknown substance C is below 10.0 degrees celsius, focus on the yellow box. The boxes are located around the kitchen.
rules: Open the door to the target room before moving into it.
Focus on the thermometer, then focus on the unknown substance before measuring.
Use the thermometer on the substance to obtain its melting-point temperature reading.
Compare the measured temperature to the threshold and focus on the box matching the above/below condition.

melt.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to melt ice. First, focus on the substance. Then, take actions that will cause it to change its state of matter.
rules: Navigate to a room containing a heat source and a cold-storage container before acting on the target substance.
Open the container holding the target substance, then focus on it before picking it up.
Transfer the substance from inventory onto a heat-producing device, then activate that device to change its state.
Confirm state change by observing the substance's description after activation.

mendelian-genetics-known-plant.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to determine whether short plant height is a dominant or recessive trait in the pea plant. If the trait is dominant, focus on the blue box. If the trait is recessive, focus on the orange box.
rules: Open the door to the target room before moving into it.
Inspect the seed container to identify the available seeds, then pick up one seed into inventory.
Inspect both candidate boxes to confirm their contents before deciding which to focus on.
Focus on the box corresponding to the inferred trait category (blue for dominant, orange for recessive).

mendelian-genetics-known-plant.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to determine whether tall plant height is a dominant or recessive trait in the pea plant. If the trait is dominant, focus on the red box. If the trait is recessive, focus on the green box.
rules: Open the door to the target room before moving into it.
Inspect candidate containers to locate the required seed or material before picking it up.
Pick up the needed seed from its container so it is in inventory.
Determine the trait status from the task, then focus on the corresponding colored box (red for dominant, green for recessive).

use-thermometer.goal:
Task Description:
Your task is to measure the temperature of unknown substance B, which is located around the living room. First, focus on the thermometer. Next, focus on the unknown substance B. If the unknown substance B temperature is above 0.0 degrees celsius, place it in the blue box. If the unknown substance B temperature is below 0.0 degrees celsius, place it in the orange box. The boxes are located around the bedroom.
rules: Focus on the thermometer before picking it up so it is available for measurement.
Use the thermometer on the target substance to read its temperature, then pick up the substance.
Choose the destination box by the measured temperature: above 0.0 degrees celsius goes to the blue box, below 0.0 degrees celsius goes to the orange box.
Open each closed door along the route before moving through it, and traverse rooms via the hallway when needed.
Place the substance into the selected box in the bedroom to complete the task.
